about: A table cell's unset text colour is color.black (#363A45) in v4, v5 and v6 (fix/pine-table-cell-text-black, e93 unit 5): a named default for every version, and the library-version check no longer holds a v5 library's table.cell without text_color.

mutants.mutant: the named cell default goes: v4 / v6 cells fall back to the renderer's fixed grey again
a v5 library's table.cell without text_color is held again, as if the versions drew it differently
